'''Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Sapphire)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 7 to cast. It imbues 10 [[sapphire bolts]] each cast and turns them into [[sapphire bolts (e)]] or 10 [[sapphire dragon bolts]] into 10 [[sapphire dragon bolts (e)]]. The enchantment gives the effect ''Clear Mind''. Each bolt has a small chance of draining and siphoning some of your opponent's [[prayer]] to you based on their [[Ranged]] level.
